stem.text: The structure of tartaric acid is shown.

stem.alt: Skeletal structure of tartaric acid, labelled tartaric acid: a four-carbon chain with a carboxylic acid group (HO and C=O) at each end and an OH group on each of the two middle carbons.

stem.text: Which statements about tartaric acid are correct?

rows: A molecule of tartaric acid has more than one chiral centre.
The molecular formula of tartaric acid is $\text{C}_4\text{H}_4\text{O}_6$.
One molecule of tartaric acid produces four hydrogen ions in aqueous solution.
